result.methodology: Median numeric / most-frequent categorical imputation, drop-first one-hot encoding; fit on training data only. SelectKBest f_regression selects encoded columns on training data. Fixed user k; three-fold training-only CV is descriptive, not test-set tuning.
result.interval_caveat: Classical 95% OLS prediction intervals assume linearity, independent errors, constant variance and approximately normal errors. Selected-model intervals condition on the selected design and omit selection uncertainty. Rank-deficient designs have intervals disabled. No outputs are clipped.
